title: Arena bracket reply — fighter level publication contract
description: Additive projection of the existing arena-bracket-1 success reply. Other bracket/receipt fields remain governed by host readArenaBracket validation. This schema documents existing published levels; it does not add a new wire field or change admission.

level.description: Immutable host combat level from the admitted match snapshot. Human: match.entrant.level; citizens: match.opponent.level. Same level as the host-issued combatant used by LV badges; never pilotRank or tournament requiredLevel. Required on replies: clients must not invent a default.
